title: Seeking to time with timestampOffset (avc-50fps-cbr-hd)
product-requirement: Client must be able to seek with timestampOffset.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.

changelog.summary: Fixed 2 race conditions: slow segment download speed can cause timeouts, appending media to buffers can commence playback before promises resolve
